settingsLoadFailed.title: Your settings could not be loaded from the server.

diagnostic.reportBugOpened: Bundle downloaded — drag the .json file into the report in the new tab
diagnostic.reportBugHint: Opens GitHub with a bug template and downloads the diagnostic bundle to attach.
diagnostic.title: Diagnostic export for a GitHub issue
diagnostic.description: Diagnostic bundle for a GitHub issue, built only from fixed fields:
diagnostic.copied: Bundle copied – paste it into the GitHub issue

includes.versions: App and build version, Node version, operating system and architecture
includes.settings: Instance switches and numbers — whether an integration exists, never its address or key
includes.counts: Counts: accounts per enabled domain, entries per table, database migration status
includes.events: Log events of the last 24 hours (errors: 7 days): time, level, code, file:line
includes.userCounts: Counts of your entries per area and which areas are on
includes.userEvents: Only your account's log events (time, level, code, location) — no server details

diagnostic.excludes: Not included: texts, names, emails, bookings, places, URLs, IP addresses, paths, request values.
diagnostic.previewLabel: Preview – exactly this file is downloaded:
diagnostic.failedSection: Section “{{section}}” could not be collected (code {{code}}) and is marked as failed in the bundle.
diagnostic.exportFailed: The diagnostic bundle could not be created: {{reason}}. “Report bug” still opens the GitHub issue – without an attachment.
diagnostic.exportFailedToast: Issue opened without a diagnostic bundle – the export failed.

reasons.rateLimited: too many exports in a short time, please try again later
reasons.forbidden: the diagnostic export is blocked for this account (shared demo account)
reasons.rejected: the bundle failed its own checklist and was withheld

diagnostic.scopeUser: You are not an administrator: the package contains only your own data, nothing about other accounts and nothing about the server.

domain.flight_desc: Import bookings, routes on the map, airline/airport achievements.
domain.cruise_desc: Ships, ports, sea days, cruise-line achievements.
domain.roadtrip_desc: Multi-day journeys by motorhome, car or bike: stations, nights, the road between.
domain.tour_desc: Hikes, rides and other day tours: route, recorded tracks, photos.
domain.rail_desc: Train journeys like flights: stations, train number, class, seat, kilometres.
domain.rental_desc: Rental cars with station, period, car and the kilometres from the invoice.
domain.bus_desc: Coach, intercity and shuttle rides: terminals, line, seat, kilometres. Not city transit.
domain.ferry_desc: Ferry crossings like flights: ports, operator, vessel, vehicle on board, cabin, kilometres.
